chunks: The venerable Sheikh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me, from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said:

Iblis (may God curse him) used to penetrate the seven heavens. When Isa (peace be upon him) was born, he was blocked from three heavens, and he would instead penetrate four heavens. When the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) was born, he was blocked from all seven, and the devils were pelted with stars. Quraysh said: 'This is the Hour that we used to hear the people of the scriptures mention.' Amr ibn Umayya, who was among the most rebuked of the people of Jahiliyya, said: 'Look at these stars by which people are guided and by which the seasons of winter and summer are known. If they have been thrown, then that is the destruction of everything. But if they have remained and other things were thrown, then it is a new matter that has occurred.'

On the morning of the Prophet's birth, all the idols had fallen on their faces. That night, the Iwan of Khosrow shook and fourteen battlements fell. Lake Sawa receded, the valley of Samawa flooded, the fires of Persia were extinguished after a thousand years. The Mobed dreamt of unruly camels leading Arabian horses across the Tigris. The arch of Khosrow cracked, the Tigris burst. A light spread from the Hijaz to the East. Every king's throne was overturned and kings were silenced. Soothsayers lost their knowledge, sorcerers' magic was nullified. Quraysh was glorified and called 'the Family of God.'

Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: They were only called the Family of God because they were in the Sacred House of God. Amina said: My son, by God, was born and upheld himself on the ground with his hand. Then he raised his head to the sky and looked at it. Then a light came out from me that illuminated everything, and I heard a speaker saying: You have given birth to the master of mankind, so name him Muhammad. Abd al-Muttalib was brought to look at him. He took him and placed him in his lap and said: Praise be to God who gave me this pure boy who prevails over the boys while in the cradle. Then he sought protection for him by the pillars of the Ka'ba and composed poetry about him.

He said: Iblis (may God curse him) screamed out to his devils. They gathered and said: What has alarmed you, our master? He said: Woe to you! I have been denied from the heavens and the earth since tonight. Something great has occurred - nothing like it since the ascension of Isa ibn Maryam. Go and find out what happened. They dispersed, returned, and said: We found nothing. Iblis said: I will handle this. He plunged into the world and reached the Sanctuary, found it surrounded by angels. He tried to enter but they screamed at him. He took the form of a small bird and entered from Hira. Gabriel said: Get behind you - may God curse you. He said: What happened tonight? He said: Muhammad was born. He said: Do I have a share in him? No. In his nation? Yes. I am satisfied.

key_terms.إيوان كسرى: The Iwan of Khosrow - the great hall of the Sassanid palace at Ctesiphon
key_terms.الحرم: The Sanctuary - the sacred precinct of Mecca
key_terms.السماوات السبع: The Seven Heavens - the seven layers of heaven in Islamic cosmology
key_terms.الموبذان: The Mobed - the Zoroastrian high priest
key_terms.بحيرة ساوة: Lake Sawa - a lake in Persia whose drying was prophesied as a sign of Islam
key_terms.نيران فارس: The Fires of Persia - sacred Zoroastrian fires that had burned for a thousand years

ai.seo_question: What miraculous signs accompanied the birth of Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), narrated in the Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq during the assembly held in Rabi al-Awwal 368 AH, describes the cosmic and earthly signs that accompanied the birth of Prophet Muhammad (SAWW). It details how Iblis was progressively blocked from the heavens, and recounts miraculous events including the falling of idols, the shaking of the Iwan of Khosrow, the drying of Lake Sawa, the extinguishing of Zoroastrian fires, and a great light from the Hijaz. The hadith includes Amina's testimony about the miraculous birth, Abd al-Muttalib's praise, and culminates with Iblis learning of the birth from Gabriel - having no share in the Prophet himself but claiming a share in his nation.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ahmad b. `Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti from Aban b. `Uthman from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as). He said:

Iblis (may Allah curse him) would penetrate the seven heavens. When `Isa (as) was born, he was blocked off from three heavens, and he would instead penetrate four heavens. When the Messenger of Allah (sw) was born, he was blocked off from all seven, and the devils were thrown into the stars [of this lower heaven]. Quraysh said: “This is the Hour that we would hear the people of the scriptures mention.” `Amr b. Umayya, who was of the most rebuked persons of Jahiliyya, said: “Look to these stars by which one can be guided and know the timings of winter and summer. If they were thrown into, then that would lead to the destruction of everything. But, if they remain, and they were thrown elsewhere, then it is a new Order.”

On the morning of the birth of the Prophet (sw), all the idols had fallen on their faces. That night, an earthquake shook the Iwan of Khosrow, and fourteen balconies fell from it. Lake Sawa receded, and the valley of Samawah was flooded. The fire of Persia was extinguished, and that had not happened for one thousand years. The Zoroastrian Mobed saw a dream that night of camels leading Arabian horses across the Tigris into their country, cutting the ring of King Khosrow from the middle. That night, a light dispersed from the direction of the Hijaz, going eastward. There was not a bed of a king from the kings except that it was flipped. The kings were silenced and could not speak that day.
The knowledge of priests was removed, the magic of sorcerers was invalided; and no soothsayer remained in Arabia except that she was barred from her partner. The Quraysh were made glorious among the Arabs, and they were called “The Family of Allah.”

Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) said: Surely, they were only called “the Family of Allah” because they were in the Sanctified House of Allah. Amina said: My son, by Allah, was born and upheld himself on the ground with his own hand. Then, he raised his head to the sky and looked at it. Then, a light left me that illuminated everything for him. I heard a speaker in the light saying: “You have given birth to the Master of People, so name him ‘Muhammad.’”
`Abd al-Muttalib came to look at him, and he was told about what Amina said. So, he took him and placed him in his Hijr. Then, he said: “Praise be to Allah who gave me this pure boy who has prevailed over the boys while in the cradle.” Then, he sought refuge for him by the foundations of the Ka`ba and said: “There are poems in it.”

He said: Iblis (la) screamed out to his devils. So, they gathered to him and said: “What has troubled you, master?” So, he said to them: “Woe to you all. On this night, I have been denied from the heavens and the Earth. Something great has occurred on Earth – nothing like it has occurred since the ascension of `Isa b. Maryam. So, go and find out what has happened.” So, they went out and came back to him, saying: “We did not find anything.” So, Iblis said: “I will find out.”
So, he plunged into the world and went through it until he ended up at the Sanctuary. He saw the Sanctuary surrounded by angels. He tried to go in, but they screamed at him, so he went back. Then, he took on the form of a bird, and he entered from the direction of Mount Hira. So, Gabriel said to him: “Behind you – may Allah curse you.” So, he said to him: “Let me ask you, Gabriel, what is this that has happened on Earth tonight?” So, he said: “Muhammad (sw) was born.” So, he said to him: “Do I have a share in him?” He said: “No.” So, he said: “Then [do I have a share] in his Nation?” He said: “Yes.” So, he was pleased.
